summary: FLOW-4 retest after fix — PASS. The frontend now correctly includes pin in the POST /api/wallet/withdraw payload via returnPinToCaller={submitWithPin} on the PinGate. E2E verified on mobile viewport (390x844): login client@sendbid.app + PIN 123456 → /(tabs); navigate /wallet/bank-transfer; fill bt-amount=10, bt-holder=John Doe, bt-iban=FR7630003000404444444444404, bt-bank=Test Bank; tap bt-submit → PinGate opens; enter PIN 123456 via pingate-key-* → pingate-submit. Network captured request body = {"amount":10,"method":"bank","pin":"123456","details":{...}} and response = 200 {ok:true, tx_id, payout_id, eta_days:3, fee:1.0}. PinGate closed. Wallet balance debited 1250.50 → 1239.50 EUR (verified via authenticated GET /api/wallet). refreshMe was called (auth user refreshed). Note: the local 'Solde Portefeuille disponible' card on the bank-transfer screen does NOT refresh after a successful submit because that screen loads wallet state once via api.get('/wallet') on mount and refreshMe only refreshes the auth user — minor stale-display issue (cosmetic, not blocking). The success Alert dismisses immediately on web (Alert.alert maps to window.alert/confirm in react-native-web) which is expected behavior. Iteration-15 RCA is fully resolved.

issues: After a successful withdraw the in-screen 'Solde Portefeuille disponible' card still shows the pre-debit balance because local wallet state is fetched once in useEffect on mount and is not re-fetched after submitWithPin. refreshMe() only updates auth user. Consider re-calling api.get('/wallet') after submit before router.back(), or moving wallet balance into the auth store. Reference: /app/frontend/app/wallet/bank-transfer.tsx:32-34, 59.

action_items: Optional polish: after a successful bank withdraw, refresh the local wallet state (re-call api.get('/wallet')) before router.back() so the card on screen reflects the new balance if the user stays on the screen. Currently only refreshMe() is called; the displayed balance remains stale until next mount.
critical_code_review_comments: FLOW-4 fix is correct and minimal: bank-transfer.tsx now uses returnPinToCaller={submitWithPin}; submitWithPin calls setPinOpen(false) FIRST then POSTs /wallet/withdraw with {amount, method, pin, details}. Backend BankWithdrawIn validates pin and require_pin() is called server-side — defence-in-depth preserved. Verified via captured network request/response.
Pre-existing console warnings persist (shadow* props deprecated, props.pointerEvents, expo-notifications web listener) — unrelated to FLOW-4.

Wallet balance after test: 1239.50 EUR (was 1250.50 EUR). Restart backend before next regression run to re-seed balance via init seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FLOW-4 (bank-transfer) is fully functional. The fix is in /app/frontend/app/wallet/bank-transfer.tsx — PinGate uses returnPinToCaller={submitWithPin} which forwards the PIN into the POST /api/wallet/withdraw payload. Backend accepts and returns 200. Demo wallet balance was debited to 1239.50 EUR during this test — sudo supervisorctl restart backend will reset to 1250.50 via seed init.
rca_of_issue: Resolved in iteration 16. Previous root cause (iter 15): PinGate was wired with onSuccess={submit} so the PIN never reached the /wallet/withdraw payload → 422 'Field required'. Fix: switch to returnPinToCaller={submitWithPin}; submitWithPin(pin) closes the modal then posts {amount, method:'bank', pin, details}. Verified end-to-end: request body contains pin, response 200, wallet debited.
